itens.titulo: Claude Platform — November 2, 2026
itens.resumo: Long conversations and agent loops on the Messages API can now send smaller requests and get a lower time to first token with message threads , in beta with the message-threads-2026-08-12 beta header. The API keeps the conversation on the server, so each later request sends only the new messages. A thread expires 5 minutes after its last request and is deleted no more than 1 hour after its last use. Message threads are available on the Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS , Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed), and Claude in Microsoft Foundry .

itens.titulo: Claude Platform — October 29, 2026
itens.resumo: We’ve launched the Usage and Cost Analytics API in beta with the analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24 beta header. Its /v1/organizations/analytics/usage and /v1/organizations/analytics/cost endpoints report token usage and cost for Claude Console and Claude Enterprise organizations. You can filter and group results by dimensions such as model, workspace, API key, and the user or service account behind each request. The Usage and Cost API is now a legacy API, and so are the usage_report , cost_report , user_usage_report , and user_cost_report endpoints of the Claude Enterprise Analytics API . All of them remain supported. To move an existing integration, see Migrate from the Usage and Cost API or Migrate from the Claude Enterprise usage and cost reports .

itens.titulo: Claude Platform — October 23, 2026
itens.resumo: The Claude Tag API is available in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations with the experimental-claude-tag-2026-10-21 beta header. Its /v1/organizations/claude_tag/ endpoints read and change Claude Tag settings on Slack channels and Slack workspaces, show which settings apply in a channel and where each comes from, and attach Access bundles. Call it with an Admin API key that your primary owner creates in claude.ai with the read:claude_tag or write:claude_tag scope. It is not available to Claude Platform (Claude Console) organizations.
